programme.title: Mentes criminales
programme.desc: Cuando un chico que desapareció en San Diego el día de Halloween reaparece un año después, la UAC debe funcionar con rapidez cuando otro chico en truco o trato desaparece bajo circunstancias similares.

programme.title: Mentes criminales

programme.title: Love Hurts
programme.desc: A riveting action comedy. A realtor is pulled back into his old life by his former partner-in-crime. With his crime-lord brother also on his trail, he must confront his past.

programme.title: The Front Room
programme.desc: In this psychological horror with dark humour, singer Brandy Norwood finds herself facing a mother-in-law from hell when a pregnant couple takes in the husband's stepmother.

programme.title: The Surfer
programme.desc: Nicholas Cage's performance drives this psychological thriller. A father revisits his childhood beach with his son, but a clash with the locals pushes him to his edge.

programme.title: Schindler's List
programme.desc: Steven Spielberg and Liam Neeson create a poignant and powerful film. After witnessing his Jewish workers' persecution by the Nazis, a German businessman decides to help them.

programme.title: Midway
programme.desc: Woody Harrelson, Patrick Wilson and Luke Evans star in this real-event-based WWII drama about the Battle of Midway, which was a clash between US and Japanese militaries.

programme.title: Abominable
programme.desc: When mischievous friends Yi, Jin, and Peng discover a young Yeti on their roof, they name him Everest and embark on a thrilling adventure to reunite the magical creature with his family.

programme.title: Finnick
programme.desc: An animation about family and responsibility. Finnick is a young Finn who doesn't seem to care about making a home out of his house. But things change when a new family arrives.

programme.title: The Bad Guys
programme.desc: Sam Rockwell lends his voice to this thrilling heist animation. Several reformed yet misunderstood criminal animals attempt to become good, with disastrous results.

programme.title: The Naked Gun From The Files Of...
programme.desc: 'The Naked Gun From The Files Of Police Squad!'. Leslie Nielsen returns for another outlandish case. This time he must foil plans to assassinate Queen Elizabeth II.

programme.title: The Naked Gun 2: The Smell Of Fear
programme.desc: The second instalment in the belly laughs-inducing police detective classic parody. Leslie Nielsen's Lt. Frank Drebin discovers a plot to kidnap a solar energy scientist.

programme.title: Naked Gun 33 1/3: The Final Insult
programme.desc: Leslie Nielsen takes centre stage in this cult classic comedy. The detective comes out of retirement to help the police infiltrate a terrorist cell planning to bomb the Oscars.

programme.title: Batman Forever
programme.desc: Val Kilmer is Batman in this Joel Schumacher-directed take on the Superhero franchise. Here, the Dark Knight is forced to contend with two villains: The Riddler and Two-Face.

programme.title: Jaws 2
programme.desc: Another killer shark terrorises the beaches of Amity in this classic horror sequel. This time, it's up to the chief of police to protect the citizens of the town.

programme.title: Drop
programme.desc: A charming dinner turns into a nightmare in this pulse-pounding thriller. While on a date, a widowed mother receives terrifying anonymous messages to kill her date or lose her son.

programme.title: The Devil's Light
programme.desc: A mystery-filled horror. A Catholic nun believes she is answering a calling to be the first female exorcist - but who or what called her?

programme.title: Medieval
programme.desc: Starring Ben Foster and Michael Caine, this is an epic take on the true story of Jan ika, one of Czech history's greatest warriors, who is said to have never lost a battle.

programme.title: 31 Million Reasons
programme.desc: Brothers Ronnie and Jugs are two Chatsworth policemen who hatch a plot to seize 31 million rands from a cash deposit facility.

programme.title: Skemerson
programme.desc: A young man battling mental illness decides to kill himself by jumping off the Bloukrans Bridge. On the bridge, he meets someone who sets his life on a completely different path.

programme.title: One Life

programme.title: Kingdoms Of Fire, Ice & Fairytales

programme.title: The Life Of Chuck

programme.title: Richard The Stork 2

programme.title: Megamind
programme.desc: A superpowered animation. A supervillain finally defeats his arch-rival, Metro Man. He soon becomes bored and creates a new hero for the town.
